summary_oneline: Fill products_found (SlotPresence list) for every product-detecting planogram type by turning the existing slot_presence reporting policy on beyond ink_wall.

merges layout-profile reporting with the per-row `slots_definition.meta.reporting` override (kill switch per configuration)
shared compare stage; computes `products_found = build_slot_presence(...) if policy.slot_presence else []` for every type
type-agnostic builder: one SlotPresence per occupied-expected (shelf, position) from definition + PositionResults
per-type layout profile field defaulting to `ReportingPolicy()`
endcap (printers on tiers, reference images) — delegates to compare_observations
shelf type (reference images) — delegates to compare_observations
zone-based endcap — delegates to compare_observations; no shelves ⇒ products_found stays []
maps a reference-image match (ref-NNNN → catalog_key) to a definition product, so a found printer's identity is the facing model
the structure to reuse unchanged for every type
serialises `products_found` in the job JSON (already type-agnostic)

shows the per-row `meta.reporting.slot_presence=false` opt-out already works
only planogram doc; has no section on reporting / products_found — to be documented

constraints.statement: products_found is already produced by the shared compare stage; the only gate is `ReportingPolicy.slot_presence` (default False), set to True only by InkWall's layout profile
constraints.implication: no per-type code is needed to fill the column; the change is a policy default (or per-type profile) plus tests and docs

constraints.statement: build_slot_presence walks `definition.shelves` and groups occupied-expected facings; every occupied facing has a non-blank `product` (validator), legacy rows map `product = name`
constraints.implication: endcap/shelf definitions produce one SlotPresence per slot with `model` = printer/product name; zone-only definitions (endcap_no_shelves_promotional) legitimately yield []

constraints.statement: a reference-image match is resolved to a definition product through `_reference_product` (catalog_key → resolve_identity)
constraints.implication: `found` / `observed` for printers detected via reference images follow the same FacingStatus semantics as ink_wall; no new identity path is required

constraints.statement: FEAT-645 explicitly scoped presence to ink_wall and encoded it in `test_non_ink_wall_result_unchanged` and AC 'empty list when presence is off'
constraints.implication: this feature reverses a recorded decision: the spec must say so and the test must be replaced by a positive assertion for a non-ink-wall type

constraints.statement: `product_label` (display_name vs product) is independent from `slot_presence`; only ink_wall switches shelf lists to model names
constraints.implication: turning presence on does not change `expected_products` / `found_products` for other types unless `product_label` is also changed — a separate, riskier decision for flowtask reports

constraints.statement: flowtask (FEAT-564) consumes `result['products_found']` without branching on planogram_type; absent key → []
constraints.implication: no downstream change needed; endcap rows will start persisting non-empty `products_found` as soon as ai-parrot-pipelines ships
a configuration can opt out (`{"reporting": {"slot_presence": false}}`) if a default-on policy is adopted

constraints.statement: the planogram package is under active ink-wall work (FEAT-646 merged 2026-10-09, WIP neighbour-spill commit b12e115c3 on dev)
constraints.implication: base the feature branch on origin/dev and keep the diff to policy/tests/docs to avoid conflicts with identify/spill changes

whats_new.item: `products_found` populated for every planogram type that runs compare_observations over a shelves-based definition (endcap_backlit_multitier, product_on_shelves, product_counter, graphic_panel_display) — same `SlotPresence` structure as ink_wall
positive tests: a product_on_shelves / endcap fixture with reference-image identifications yields one SlotPresence per slot with `found` True/False/None

documentation of `ReportingPolicy` (`slot_presence`, `product_label`, `misplaced_min_confidence`), the per-row meta override and the `products_found` contract in docs/pipelines/planogram-compliance-cycle.md

what_changes.change: Option A (recommended): `slot_presence` default flips to True — one-line change; every type inherits it; rows opt out via `meta.reporting`
Option B (alternative): set `reporting=ReportingPolicy(slot_presence=True)` per product-detecting type (and product_on_shelves, product_counter); keeps the policy default False
replace with `test_non_ink_wall_products_found` asserting a non-empty, model-labelled presence list while `expected_products` keep display-name labels
cross-reference: AC 'empty list when presence is off' remains true but the default changes; note superseded by FEAT-648

untouched: `SlotPresence` model, `build_slot_presence`, `compare_observations`, `_assemble`, the aiohttp handler — all already type-agnostic (F001, F003, F005)

scoring, credits, FacingStatus semantics, reference-image selection (F005, F008)
